retry_reason.detail: Resume V2-CAT-01 on existing PR #181 from application HEAD 70583ddf68955e675fe71e21ce465be0cff542e4 after criterion-complete independent review 35529973203 returned REVISE. Fix ONLY the two demonstrated remaining application defects. Preserve R002/R004/R005/R006/R007/R008/R009/R010 unchanged. In particular do NOT alter swipe/orchestration now that R007 is CONFORME.
